methodologyNotes: Covers electric hair clippers made for cutting head and body hair with guide combs, including professional barber clippers and home haircut clippers, corded and cordless. Excludes beard and detail trimmers (see beard-trimmers), foil/rotary electric shavers (see electric-shavers), and dedicated body groomers. Price is typical US street price or MSRP in USD. motorType is the drive mechanism: rotary, magnetic, pivot, or linear. powerType is corded, cordless, or cord-cordless (runs both plugged in and on battery). maxSpeedRpm is the manufacturer-stated maximum no-load motor speed in RPM; for magnetic and pivot motors this is the equivalent strokes per minute. batteryLifeMin is rated cordless runtime in minutes on a full charge; null if corded-only. chargeTimeMin is time to a full charge in minutes; null if corded-only. bladeMaterial is the cutting-blade alloy or coating: stainless-steel, carbon-steel, ceramic, titanium, or DLC. bladeSystem is how blade length is set: adjustable-taper (side lever), detachable (swappable fixed-size blades), or fixed. cutLengthRangeMm is the blade-only cutting-length range set by the taper lever, in millimeters (guide combs add length on top of this); null if the blade is fixed. numGuards is the count of guide combs / attachment combs included in the box. weightGrams is the bare tool weight in grams, without cord or guards. washable is true when the blades are rinseable under water or the body carries a published water-resistance rating.

products.name: Andis ReVite
products.priceNote: US MSRP $149.99 stated verbatim on the Andis manufacturer page (andis.com item #86100, "reVITE Clipper - Gray", "$149.99"); the same $149.99 also appears on the Black variant page (item #86000). Authorized retailer ProStylingTools lists a sale price of "$139.99" for the identical model (Andis SKU 86100).
products.provenance: The Andis manufacturer page for item #86100 (reVITE Clipper - Gray, Model MTC) confirms this exact model and states verbatim: Clipper Motor Type Rotary, Strokes per Minute 5500 SPM, Volts 100-240 V, Battery Runtime 2 hours (Lithium-Ion), Corded/Cordless operation, Stainless Steel Blades, an adjustable/removable blade design, a set of 12 metal clip attachment combs, and an MSRP of $149.99. The ProStylingTools retailer page corroborates the identical model (Andis SKU 86100, "reVITE Cordless Clipper w/ Taper Blade MTC (86100)"), repeating the rotary motor, 2-hour Lithium-Ion runtime, Corded/Cordless, Stainless Steel Blades, Adjustable Blade, and 12 premium metal clip attachment combs, and lists an authorized sale price of $139.99. Bare-tool weight is published only in ounces and differs by color variant (Black 11.5 oz vs. Gray 10.3 oz), so weightGrams is left null; charge time, blade-only cut-length range, a washable/water-resistance rating, and a release year are not published on either fetched page.

products.name: Andis Master Cordless
products.priceNote: US MSRP $229.99 listed verbatim on the official Andis store product page (item 12660, "Master® Cordless Clipper").
products.provenance: The official Andis product page (item 12660, "Master® Cordless Clipper", model MLC, Made in USA) confirmed this exact model and listed a $229.99 US price, a Rotary motor rated 6500 SPM, carbon-steel blades adjustable "000 to 1", corded/cordless operation, and a "1 hour 30 min" battery runtime; its "What's Included" list (charger stand, adapter, blade guard, oil) contains no guide combs, so numGuards is 0. Shave Nation's retailer listing corroborated the identity of the "ANDIS Master Cordless Lithium-Ion Clipper" and stated "over 90 minutes" of runtime plus the rotary motor and carbon-steel 000-to-1 blade, supporting batteryLifeMin 90. Weight is published only in ounces (13.2 oz) and blade length only as Andis sizes, so weightGrams and cutLengthRangeMm were left null; charge time (retailer sources contradict each other) and a release year were not stated verbatim, so both were left null.

products.provenance: The official JRL USA page (jrlusa.com, the manufacturer's official U.S. source) lists this exact model, the "Onyx Professional Cordless Hair Clipper," at a regular price of $195.00 USD, with dual speeds of 6,000 & 7,500 RPM, a stainless steel Onyx Fade blade with a 0.5-3.5 mm range, a 5-position lever-lock taper system, and 10 guard combs. ProStylingTools, an authorized JRL distributor, corroborates the identical model (SKU JRL-FF2020C-B) at $194.95 with matching specs (6,000 & 7,500 RPM, 3.5 mm max fade blade, Reset IQ charging, 10 comb guards), and Walmart's listing (model #2020C-B) matches the same feature set, confirming model identity. Battery runtime (5 h), charge time (3 h), and weight (12.7 oz) were stated only in hours/ounces, so the minute/gram spec fields are left null rather than converted, and motorType/washable/releaseDate are null because no page states them.

products.provenance: The manufacturer babylisspro.com product page for FX899MB is behind bot protection and returns a 404 interstitial to automated fetches, so it cannot serve as a re-fetchable source; the source is therefore prostylingtools.com, an Official U.S. Distributor, whose FX899MB page confirms this exact model — the FXONE BLACKFX cordless clipper — with an N1 brushless motor rated "6,800RPM / 13,600SPM", an interchangeable FXBB24 lithium battery "up to 2.5 hours of runtime", a "Black Titanium Metal Injection Molded (MIM) Fade Blade (FX8022B)", and a zero-gap "5-Detent locking stretch taper lever"; it also lists the price at sale $199.95 / regular $299.99. certifiedclippers.com independently corroborates the identical FX899MB spec set (same 6,800 RPM / 13,600 SPM, 2.5-hour FXBB24 battery, FX8022B MIM blade, 5-detent taper) at $219.99. Both pages confirm this is the FXONE clipper (not the Lo-ProFX FX829 or a trimmer/shaver variant); batteryLifeMin=150 is the exact minute conversion of the stated "2.5 hours", maxSpeedRpm=6800 uses the RPM figure for the rotary/brushless drive, and chargeTimeMin, cutLengthRangeMm, numGuards, weightGrams, and washable are null because no fetched page states them.
